record.question: Choose the correct homophone to fill in the blank: He drank a __________ tumbler of milk.
record.explanation: Answer C: whole. “Whole” means entire, modifying the tumblerful of milk; hole and howl have different meanings. Original paper prints three choices; the empty imported fourth slot was removed after visual source inspection. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
